title: Google Stock (GOOGL) Falls 1.1% as Tech Stocks Retreat (Nov 24)
summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) fell 1.08% to $279.05 on Nov 24 as chip and AI stocks retreated, a smaller drop than the Nasdaq's 1.48% slide.
body_markdown:
## Why Google Stock Fell


None of the reports reviewed for this article named a company-specific reason for Alphabet's decline on November 24, and no Alphabet statement tied to the move was found.


According to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-tuesday-november-24-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-chip-stocks-nvidia-140629923.html) , tech stocks fell on Tuesday, led by declines in the chip sector, as Nvidia gave back part of its 31% surge from the prior session after its board[reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-24-2026/) . Yahoo Finance reported that semiconductor stocks declined alongside other areas of the AI trade as worries about a December rate hike returned to focus.


Alphabet had joined that rally a day earlier. As reported by[Trefis](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-did-alphabet-stock-move-172440866.html) , the shares rose 6.3% on Monday, November 23, to close at $282.10 during the AI-stock rally that followed Huang's return, with no earnings report or SEC filing around the move.


Google's own chip plans also drew attention during the session. Per[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/broadcom-stocks-fall-3-98-165405396.html) , TF International analyst Ming-Chi Kuo expects Google could take about 1 million fewer TPU-8i chips in 2027, roughly 20% of expected volume, a report neither company has confirmed. GuruFocus tied the report to Broadcom's decline on November 24, not to Alphabet's, and[24/7 Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/billionaire-charlie-munger-protege-li-215858546.html) noted that Barron's reported on November 20 that Google is cutting AI chip shipments.


## GOOGL Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Google Cloud revenue grew 103% year over year to $30.71 billion in the third quarter, according to 24/7 Wall St., and management said on the October 28 earnings call that "AI infrastructure and solutions are the major drivers for Cloud growth," per Trefis.
- Third-quarter revenue rose 24.65% year over year to $127.58 billion, with an operating margin of 32.03%, according to 24/7 Wall St.


### Risks


- Capital spending rose 114% to $51.36 billion in the third quarter, leaving[free cash flow](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/free-cash-flow-and-net-cash-flow-explained-2/) at negative $9.07 billion, with the spending funded partly through new debt, according to 24/7 Wall St.
- The unconfirmed Kuo report on lower 2027 TPU-8i volumes, published by GuruFocus, adds uncertainty around Google's AI chip plans.
- Worries about a December rate hike returned to focus on November 24, per Yahoo Finance, as AI-linked shares fell.


Alphabet's next quarterly report is expected in February 2027, according to Trefis; this is an estimate, not a confirmed date.
